file02ProductBoundary.heading: ## Current V1 product boundary and required successors
file02ProductBoundary.note: D-011: DR-117 covers these seven by reference. Any change to that enumeration re-opens DR-117. This candidate does not change the enumeration.

preservedV1Decisions.P-1: NO_ECOSYSTEM_DEPTH_FOR_V1. No marketplace, public lifecycle parity, extension discovery service, or ecosystem governance depth.
preservedV1Decisions.P-2: NARROW_CONTRIBUTION_ONTOLOGY. Contributions are narrow producers or data-only rules/profiles. They never own root commands, policy, persistence, rendering, termination, or host lifecycle.
preservedV1Decisions.G3-SUBSTRATE: DELIVERY_V2_BINDING remains the V1 substrate default. This candidate does not replace it.

sevenItemsForPreview.previewDisposition: EXCLUDED. Preview ships no marketplace, public catalog, or governance depth. V1 P-1 preserved.
EXCLUDED. Preview has no external lifecycle parity and no discovery service. First-party/explicitly-trusted install only.
EXCLUDED. Preview admits only first-party/explicitly-trusted components under DR-128's MVP boundary and D-012's identity/namespace policy. No third-party contribution ontology is opened.

sevenItemsForPreview.item: untrusted native or WASM admission and required enforcement evidence
sevenItemsForPreview.previewDisposition: EXCLUDED. Untrusted native and WASM are not admitted. DR-128 remains post-MVP. No enforcement evidence is claimed; exclusion is by non-admission.

sevenItemsForPreview.item: imperative contributions, probes, project hooks, and root commands
sevenItemsForPreview.previewDisposition: EXCLUDED as contribution roles. Host-owned doctor consented probes remain host acts (D-032 / doctor-contract.v4), not contribution-granted probes. No contributor may own a root command.
EXCLUDED. Preview analyze is offline. Doctor default is no-network. Consented doctor probes are not a network-granted analysis default.

sevenItemsForPreview.item: replacement of the full-default G3 physical substrate
sevenItemsForPreview.previewDisposition: NOT REPLACED. D-002 selected TypeScript as the sole preview language role and a CLI-first host. That is a slice role selection, not a G3 successor. G3 remains the V1 substrate default. Preview does not ship a new default substrate/profile.

whatMayBeDesigned: A first-party TypeScript analysis preview under D-002 / D-018.
CLI analyze / doctor / help / version with no marketplace, no public catalog, and no third-party lifecycle.
Admission that refuses untrusted native/WASM, imperative contributor roles, and network-granted analysis by default.
whatMustNotBePretendedSettled: Enforcement evidence as QUALIFIED or DEMONSTRATED. Exclusion by non-admission is the preview posture, not a demonstrated confinement proof.
enforcementHonesty: File 08's DR-010 acceptance cell asks for trust and enforcement evidence. This candidate supplies a product posture of non-admission, not a qualified enforcement harness. Qualification remains DR-G07 / DR-G09 / DR-G21 / DR-128 as applicable. A later full successor that admits any excluded item must bring enforcement evidence then. CD-RT-5 is untouched.
condition1EffectIfOwnerRecorded: May discharge condition 1 for DR-010 within architecture-preview scope only, by scoped product disposition of the seven items as EXCLUDED / NOT REPLACED. DR-117 (condition 2) and DR-011-R16 remain independently required; a later recording may close them only within the same preview exclusion scope, never by claiming a full P-1/P-2/G3 successor. Conditions 2-5 remain. Condition 5 remains the only authorization for docs/v2/implementation/. This file existing, or an ACCEPT verdict, is not owner recording.

Does not amend P-1, P-2, G3-SUBSTRATE, or CD-RT-5 in the product packet.
